journey.name: wear balance unit swap
journey.description:
A tap on the balance swaps the large and small units, and the choice survives an app restart. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Restored wallet, see journeys/wear/README.md › Restored wallet, with Bitcoin as the large unit. Backend: hosted regtest. The fiat value needs the Blocktank rates, so the watch must be online.

actions.action: Verify "WatchHomeBalanceSymbol" reads "₿", "WatchHomeBalance" reads the balance in sats ("1 000") and "WatchHomeBalanceSecondary" reads the fiat value
Verify "WatchHomeBalanceSymbol" reads "$", "WatchHomeBalance" reads the fiat value and "WatchHomeBalanceSecondary" reads the sats amount
Dump `android layout` every 5 s until it lists "WatchHomeBalance", for up to 1 minute
Verify "WatchHomeBalanceSymbol" still reads "$" and "WatchHomeBalance" reads the fiat value
Verify "WatchHomeBalanceSymbol" reads "₿" again, which leaves the wallet as the precondition found it
